Asset type: production game sprite atlas, Mint high-resolution movement frames, sheet 1 of 4.
Input 1 is the exact 4-column by 5-row EDIT TARGET containing 20 tiny original animation poses. Input 2 is the same character's higher-detail model sheet, ONLY for costume, face and staff identity. Input 3 is the approved QUALITY/style reference, use the blond priestess quality on this board, not the knight or scene layout.
Redraw all 20 sprites from input 1 as beautiful crisp premium hand-painted anime SD game sprites with clear face, defined fingers, elegant gold embroidery, precise blue orb staff metal, separate hair locks, polished folds and restrained soft cel shadows. This must be fresh detailed linework, not upscaling or smearing original pixels. Maintain the original 2.7-head SD silhouette and exact pose, direction, lean, staff location and phase of EVERY cell. Column 1 FRONT, column 2 BACK, column 3 RIGHT profile, column 4 LEFT profile throughout all five rows. Preserve subtle differences between rows, do not make all poses identical.
Output one portrait PNG with true transparent alpha background, exactly 4 equal columns and 5 equal rows, ideally 1600 x 2000 or larger for about 300px-tall native character bodies. Every complete character and weapon must fit wholly within its own cell with generous transparent margin all sides. Exactly 20 characters, one centered per cell. All cells same scale and consistent anatomy/identity.
White and purple cleric robes with gold trim, long blond hair, blue eyes, white-purple hat, dark staff shaft with ornate gold head and blue orb. Do not replace the staff or change held hand. Maintain clothing and metal colors across all poses.
No text, borders, panel lines, ground, shadows outside silhouette, painted background, checkerboard pattern, sparkles, VFX, glow, extra weapons, contact sheets within cells, labels or watermark. Transparent pixels between all sprites. Do not crop feet, hat, hair or staff.

Use case: precise-object-edit
This is a production sprite atlas EDIT. Keep all twenty Mint sprite poses, detailed artwork, identity, costumes and facing directions exactly as supplied. Correct ONLY the spacing / layout. Arrange on a TRUE transparent PNG in EXACT equal 4 columns by 5 rows. Within EVERY cell, all parts of character including staff, hair, hat and feet must occupy at most central 70% width and central 76% height. Thus adjacent cells have a huge fully transparent empty gutter, minimum 15% of a cell on each side. Center each complete pose inside its cell and keep a single uniform character scale for all cells. A clean 1600x2000 high-resolution image is preferred, all twenty characters fully contained. Nothing at all on cell borders or outer image borders. Make those gutters pure alpha=0. Keep high-quality fine linework and colors inside sprite unchanged. No red/pink/blue color fringing. Do not add any text, grid lines, backdrop, checkerboard pattern, floor shadow or decoration. Exactly20 distinct sprites, fourcolumns five rows.
